title: .agents/guard.yaml (single source of the deny and ask command rules)
description: The generator renders Claude permissions.deny / permissions.ask, the Claude PreToolUse guard hook (matcher Bash|PowerShell, onFailure block), .codex/hooks.json (deny only) and .codex/rules/agentive.rules (experimental) from this file. Hooks never return ask: with a human present an ask rule is left to permissions.ask; with no human present (no_human_run, revised 2026-10-27: AGENTIVE_HEADLESS=1, CI or GITHUB_ACTIONS, or permission_mode dontAsk in hook input that carries it; CLAUDE_CODE_REMOTE is not a signal; no signal = interactive) the hook denies with a handoff reason. An ask rule that a permission rule cannot express (expressible: false) is rendered as deny and init warns. A repo override may add rules or turn ask into deny, never remove a framework rule or turn deny into ask (checked by the generator). There is no pack field: infra, DB and k8s rules are always on.

kind.description: argv_prefix: exact argv prefix after normalization (also used for Codex rules); regex: on the normalized command text; special: a named check implemented in the hook (default_branch_push, unresolvable_rm_var, sql_without_where)

unless.description: argv tokens or regexes that exempt the command (for example --dry-run); such a rule is matched only in the hook, because permissions.deny cannot carve exceptions

next.description: the next action, printed as BLOCKED <id>: <reason>. NEXT: <next>

expressible.description: false: no permission rule can express it -> deny + init warning
